slots.headline: Slice by what a customer can do, not by layer

do.text: and build every layer it needs, thinly.
Generalise when the third one arrives.
to one team first, then widen.

comes_back: A merge that's small enough to review in one sitting.
avoid: "API first, UI later." That's two batches, not two slices.

callout.text: If a slice can't be demoed to a customer, it isn't a slice yet.

slots.headline:
Pick one story.
Ship half of it by Friday.
slots.sub: Then tell us what you learned at the next demo.
